--- a/scrapy/utils/request.py
+++ b/scrapy/utils/request.py
@@ -79,7 +79,7 @@ def request_httprepr(request):

     if request.headers:
         s += request.headers.to_string() + b"\r\n"
     s += b"\r\n"
